name: @pi-in-go/pigpen-powerline
description: Go port of pi-powerline-footer: a powerline-style status bar of configurable segments (model, path, git, tokens, cost, context, time) with presets, separators, /powerline, the prompt queue, stash, welcome, vibes, /cd and /reply (with the editor chrome, bash mode, delayed send and the opt-in profiler)
author: Michael Kinsy
